Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the screen yesterday. Ashwin is excited about the Senior Backend Engineer role. We typically do two short reference calls (one manager, one peer) — 20 minutes each — to validate leadership/ownership and collaboration.

Can you and the team do two 20-min calls tomorrow (Tue 9/22) between 10:30–13:30 PT or Wednesday 9/23 between 9:00–12:00 PT? If those windows don’t work, tell me two concrete slots and I’ll coordinate.

I’m attaching Ashwin’s resume and our brief reference questionnaire (quick yes/no + a couple open prompts). If you want us to use the questionnaire on the call, say so; we can also share the form with the referees ahead of time.

I don’t have the referees’ contact details on file yet — I can request them from Ashwin now (usually he lists a manager and a senior peer). Also confirm whether Redwood is OK with recording the calls for hiring notes (we store them in the recruiting folder, access limited).

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Refs for Ashwin Reddy — debrief and notes

Folks — quick debrief from the two 20-min calls (notes attached: ashwin_refs_notes_20260922.txt). TL;DR: both refs endorsed Ashwin; minor concerns on long-term ownership in highly ambiguous codebases but strong execution record. Recommendation: move to final onsite / take-home assignment.

Summary (high level):
- Nina Kapoor (manager):
  • Strong on delivery — led a team-level migration, consistently met milestones.
  • Escalation example: Ashwin owned spike work, coordinated across infra and product, escalated early when rollout caused perf regressions, then drove rollback + remediation plan.
  • Weakness: delegated some low-level debugging to more junior engineers; recommended pairing for early ramp.

- Michael Turner (peer):
  • Excellent collaborator in cross-team projects; good code-review hygiene and pragmatic about tradeoffs.
  • Noted Ashwin sometimes opts for established patterns vs exploring novel solutions — safe and predictable.

Action items:
- I recommend we invite Ashwin for the final onsite/take-home step. If Dev + Lauren agree, I’ll coordinate availability and send the next-stage invite.
- Dev: confirm whether you want me to surface any of the specific escalation details to the interview debrief (I can redact specifics).
- Lauren: I captured a couple of code-review examples if you want them pulled into the interview guide.

Attachments: ashwin_refs_notes_20260922.txt

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
T: 510-555-0199
